info.title: Provider API for Invoice Cancellation
info.description:
Provides functionality for cancelling an invoice when integrating SAP Logistics Business Network with other systems.
This specification describes the API from the perspective of SAP Logistics Business Network as the provider of the API.
Other systems call the defined endpoints within SAP Logistics Business Network.

x-sap-shortText: Enables carriers to cancel an invoice document during freight settlement process.

eu10.description:
To use the EU10 data center API, you must obtain the OAuth client credentials (client ID and secret). 
To get the OAuth client credentials, create a customer incident on SAP support portal with the component as SBN-LBN-INT. 
Provide the SAP Business Network for Logistics ID created for your account and the email address to receive your client credentials. 
Specify the target integration platform as ‘Multi-Cloud (new)’ and the title as ‘SAP BN4L Integration Platform Migration: Request for new OAuth 2.0 credential’. 
Once you receive the credentials, pass the details to SAP HANA Cloud Platform token endpoint to obtain an access token.
